notes_summary: Large-scale embeddings + reranking POC for internal code search. High reindex cadence, strict SSO/SAML and EU residency requirements. Prefers dedicated/private deployment; cost per query and latency SLOs are critical.
notes:
POC scope: replace existing hybrid search (Elasticsearch + ad-hoc embeddings) for internal engineering code search. Key metrics requested by infra:
- Index scale: expect 180-500M vectors after initial migration; ~3TB raw vector data (1536 dims, float16 quantized targets)
- Reindex cadence: daily incremental + weekly full reindex; must support frequent partial rebuilds without global downtime
- Query profile: top-k retrieval + neural rerank on top-5; median queries/sec 65, 95th percentile spikes 450 QPS (8:00–10:00 UTC)
- Latency SLO: reranked response (end-to-end) < 300ms p95 for internal dev traffic; aim for <150ms for basic vector-only lookup
- Cost target: average cost-per-query (end-to-end) <= $0.05 for baseline; acceptable to be higher during bursts if autoscale kicks in
- Model preferences: use open 1536-d embedding model (in-house compatible) + lightweight reranker (T0-like small cross-encoder). Want ability to push custom reranker weights later.
Security/compliance:
- Must integrate with SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning; audit logs retained 90 days; KMS-backed encryption of vectors at rest; EU data residency for some teams
- Need answers for security questionnaire (sent). Legal flagged vendor risk for on-prem fallback.
Deployment:
- Preferred: Redwood Dedicated in Azure West Europe with VPC peering to our subnet; dev environment can be on-prem with Private appliance for air-gapped tests
- Wants clear fallback policies: if dedicated capacity constrained, route to smaller hosted variant with degraded reranking (approx. 50% quality) rather than fail
Technical considerations discussed on call:
- ANN engine: they asked about HNSW vs IVF+PQ and warm-up/KV cache behaviour for reranker integration
- Caching: heavy prefix reuse for code snippets (same repo functions searched often) -> suggest prefix/KV caching + query-aware batching
- Reindexing: transactional incremental to avoid re-ingesting entire corpus; delta ingestion API and hooks for CI pipeline
- Observability: token-level and per-route latency breakdowns required; cost attribution per-team (internal chargeback)
Sales/ops items:
- Requested dedicated pricing for reserved pool (3 GPU nodes initial commit) + burst capacity pricing
- Security questionnaire follow-up by 2026-03-10 (legal deadline)
- POC success criteria: ingest 50M vectors in 72h, p95 rerank latency <300ms at 200 QPS, end-to-end avg cost <$0.05
Quote from head of search eng: "We can't tolerate 2–3 minute reindexes — need partial rebuilds and fast deltas. Also want reproducible rerank results for audits."
"We like Redwood's route-level observability but need tighter guarantees on cost per query at scale."
